# AngelScript 2.38.0

This directory vendors the source release of AngelScript 2.38.0 and the
`scriptbuilder` / `scriptstdstring` add-ons used by the Potato Engine mod
runtime.

Official source: <https://www.angelcode.com/angelscript/downloads.html>

The library is linked statically as `potato_angelscript`. The upstream license
notice is preserved in the source and public header files. No upstream source
files in this directory have been modified.
